svg.text: From curl to a working machine
install.sh, then the launcher, then Python
install.sh checks git, curl, tar and xz, installs missing ones with apt, then clones the
It links ~/.local/bin/ws-host to the launcher and runs it once with
The launcher fetches mise, and checks its SHA-256 against bootstrap.env before unpacking
mise installs the pinned Python and uv into its own store
